subject: HelixCare onboarding: streaming + tool-calling feature handoff
messages:
From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@helixcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding: streaming + tool-calling kickoff

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Samir and I are excited to get feature enablement started. We want to prioritize: streaming outputs for long-form patient summaries, function/tool calls to our scheduling API, and structured JSON outputs for downstream ingestion.

Attached is our internal onboarding packet (high level): helixcare-onboarding-MAP.xlsx — it includes stakeholders, HIPAA contact, and a rough timeline. For next steps, can we do a 60-minute kickoff this week to align on success criteria and an initial mutual action plan?

Quick context:
- Primary success metric: 95% of automated summaries pass schema validation and human QA acceptance at 1k samples.
- Security: SOC2 in progress; need to confirm data retention & audit log visibility requirements.

Suggested times: Wed 12/2 10:30–11:30 PT or Thu 12/3 09:00–10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Elise
Elise Turner
Senior PM, Product Integrations
HelixCare

--
Attachment: helixcare-onboarding-MAP.xlsx (stated size: 78KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@helixcare.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcare.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: streaming + tool-calling kickoff

Elise — great to hear, and thanks for sending the packet. Wed 12/2 10:30 PT works for me; I booked the slot and sent a calendar invite. Agenda draft below — please modify if needed: 

Agenda (60m):
- 0–10m: Introductions, success metrics (Neha/Elise)
- 10–25m: Technical scope & constraints (streaming length targets, tool interface)
- 25–40m: Data & security: retention, PII handling, audit logs (Samir/Neha)
- 40–50m: Mutual action plan + owners (deliverables + dates)
- 50–60m: Optional canary plan and next steps

I've attached a short checklist for streaming/toolcall readiness: redwood-streaming-checklist.pdf. Can you also drop a sample of the current scheduling API spec and any JSON schema you use for patient summaries? If you prefer, upload to the Drive folder you included in the MAP.

I pulled three recommended internal owners to bring into the call based on the scope: Marcus Lin (runtime/quant profiles), Tessa Morgan (CS / onboarding lead), and Jonas Weber (security/priv infra). I'll include them in follow-ups for specific action items.

See you Wednesday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-streaming-checklist.pdf (stated size: 24KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Turner <elise.turner@helixcare.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: HelixCare kickoff recap + immediate action items

Team — thanks for joining the kickoff. Quick recap and owners (pulled from today's meeting):

Summary: HelixCare wants streaming patient summaries + function calls into scheduling and strict structured JSON outputs for downstream HQ ingestion. Primary constraints: <100ms token latency targets on interactive review flows and HIPAA controls on PII.

Immediate action items:
- Marcus: provide recommended model variant(s) + quantization profile and a first-pass batch perf estimate for 1k/day summary generation by 2026-12-06. Deliverable: one-page perf sheet (PDF).
- Tessa: own the mutual action plan doc and coordinate the HelixCare onboarding MAP updates. Send the MAP to HelixCare by 2026-12-04.
- Jonas: capture the exact audit log surface area HelixCare expects and confirm whether Private deployment options are needed for the first phase. Reply by 2026-12-05.
- Neha (me): provide example structured output schemas and a suggested canary test plan; coordinate DocuSign SOW. Deliverable by 2026-12-04.

Additional notes from the call:
- HelixCare will provide a representative set of 100 summaries and the scheduling API OpenAPI spec this week.
- They want an initial canary in a sandbox environment before any production routing; suggested cadence: 100 samples internal QA -> 500 samples canary -> scale.

Elise/HelixCare: I've linked the shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_OnboardingDocs) and uploaded our onboarding checklist and a sample JSON schema (helixcare-sample-schema.json). Please confirm the fields we outlined for the structured output (patient_id, encounter_id, summary_text, severity_label, metadata.{source,timestamp})

Next internal sync: I'll consolidate deliverables and confirm dates on Friday.

Thanks,
Neha

--
Quoted in-line from Elise's earlier note:
> Hi Neha,
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week — Samir and I are excited to get feature enablement started.

Attachment referenced: helixcare-sample-schema.json (stated size: 6KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelixCare kickoff recap + immediate action items

Neha — I'll take the model mapping and quant profiles. Plan:
- Target model: rwd-large-v2 (low latency profile) and rwd-medium-q4 (cost optimized) as fallback.
- Quantization: q4_0 for the primary to keep quality; provide an A/B perf run for q4_0 vs q8 by 2026-12-06.
- Deliverable: perf sheet + recommended batch sizes and a short note on expected token-level cost.

I'll also draft a sample structured JSON schema for the summary output that enforces 'summary_text' max-length and enumerated severity_label values. Expect the schema draft by EOD 2026-12-06.

--
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Infra Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@helixcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcare.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: streaming + tool-calling kickoff

Neha, Marcus — thanks for the quick follow-ups. We've uploaded the scheduling OpenAPI spec to the Drive folder and added 100 representative summaries (folder: /samples/initial_100). We'll plan to start the sandbox canary once you confirm the schema & perf doc.

One ask from compliance: for the canary phase we need to see (1) an audit log sample showing request/response metadata and (2) a clear description of retention TTLs before any real PHI is ingested. If Private deployment is going to be recommended, flag that in your notes.

Looking forward to the schema draft and perf sheet. If it's easier, can Marcus and Neha run a brief 20-minute alignment tomorrow to walk through the schema before the 12/06 deliverable?

Best,
Elise

--
Attachment: scheduling_openapi.yaml (stated size: 34KB)
